description: This file defines the DocumentRenderer class within the MigraDoc.Rendering namespace, responsible for rendering a MigraDoc Document object to a graphics context, including page rendering, document object rendering, and managing rendering state and progress.

classes.name: DocumentRenderer
classes.description: Provides methods to render the document or parts of it to a XGraphics object, including page rendering, object rendering, and progress reporting.

classes.name: DocumentRenderer.PredefinedFontsAndChars
classes.description: Caches predefined fonts and characters used for rendering errors, bullets, etc.

classes.name: DocumentRenderer.PredefinedFontsAndChars.PredefinedBullets
classes.description: Provides methods to get bullet fonts and characters for list rendering.

classes.name: DocumentRenderer.PrepareDocumentProgressEventArgs
classes.description: Event arguments used during document preparation progress events.

methods.name: PrepareDocument
methods.description: Prepares the document for rendering, including layout and formatting.

methods.name: RenderPage
methods.description: Renders a specific page of the document to a graphics context with optional elements.

methods.name: GetDocumentObjectsFromPage
methods.description: Returns the document objects rendered on a specific page.

methods.name: GetRenderInfoFromPage
methods.description: Returns the render information for document objects on a specific page.

methods.name: RenderObject
methods.description: Renders a single document object to the graphics context at a specified position.

methods.name: AddOutline
methods.description: Adds an outline (bookmark) to the PDF at the specified position.

methods.name: NextListNumber
methods.description: Calculates the next list number for numbered lists, maintaining list continuity across the document.
